prompt: Make me an SVG diagram in the WLILO style that explains how HTTP caching works — I want it to cover ETags, Cache-Control max-age, and 304 revalidation. It's going in our team's engineering docs, so it needs to be genuinely correct, not hand-wavy.
assertions: SVG file exists, parses as XML, and has a viewBox
WLILO palette adherence: at least 3 distinct token hexes from the WLILO tables and at least 60% of all hex colors used are WLILO tokens
Never-flat rule: at least one linearGradient is defined and used
Technical correctness markers all present in text: ETag, max-age, 304, If-None-Match
Glyph vocabulary used: at least one emoji or WLILO unicode glyph (block/geometric/arrow/star) appears in text
